# **KYOCERA FY27 1H SEGMENT FINANCIALS & FORWARD OUTLOOK**

**1\. Industrial Tools Unit** (Solutions Business) 
• **1H Performance:** Sales JPY 106.8B (9.9% of tot) | OP JPY 19.2B (23.0% of tot) [Margin: 17.9%] 
• **2H Outlook:** Sales & profit expected to decline vs 1H. 
• **Drivers & Risks:** 1H boosted by pull-forward buying ahead of 3-round tungsten price hikes; 2H hit by full raw material cost increases.

**2\. Semiconductor Components Unit** (Core Components) 
• **1H Performance:** Sales JPY 221.1B (20.5% of tot) | OP JPY 31.5B (37.7% of tot) [Margin: 14.2%] 
• **2H Outlook:** Lower 2H underlying profit; offset by \~JPY 15B Chemical Business sale gain. 
• **Drivers & Risks:** 1H smartphone package pull-forward; organic packages at full capacity; upside potential from AI market demand.

**3\. Electronic Components Business** • **1H Performance:** Sales JPY 215.3B (20.0% of tot) | OP JPY 19.6B (23.5% of tot) [Margin: 9.1%] • **2H Outlook:** 2H performance may match or exceed 1H levels. • **Drivers & Risks:** Strong AI data center MLCC/capacitor demand & KAVX yield gains; solid inquiries extending into FY28.

**4\. Document Solutions Unit** (Solutions Business) • **1H Performance:** Sales JPY 248.2B (23.0% of tot) | OP JPY 29.6B (35.5% of tot) [Margin: 11.9%] • **2H Outlook:** Demand & profit expected to moderate in 2H. • **Drivers & Risks:** Fading of non-recurring 1H US tariff refunds & customer pre-buys hedging memory cost increases.

**5\. Industrial & Automotive Components** (Core Components - SPE) 
• **1H Performance:** Sales JPY 134.1B (12.4% of tot) | OP JPY 19.2B (23.0% of tot) [Margin: 14.3%] 
• **2H Outlook:** 2H upside potential from semiconductor processing equipment (SPE) demand. 
• **Drivers & Risks:** High SPE ceramic demand; Isahaya plant operational Spring 2027 (targeting JPY 25B/yr from FY31).

**6\. Communications Unit** (Solutions Business) 
• **1H Performance:** Sales JPY 106.9B (9.9% of tot) | OP JPY 7.9B (9.5% of tot) [Margin: 7.4%] 
• **2H Outlook:** Stable 2H seasonal trend execution. 
• **Drivers & Risks:** Ongoing business portfolio and cost structure optimization.
---
## *Total 1H Sales Revenue: JPY 1,078.3B | Total 1H Business Profit: JPY 83.5B*#\================================================================================ 

**KEY FORWARD GUIDANCE & STRATEGIC TAKEAWAYS**
• **Full-Year Guidance:** Sales revised **+JPY 40B to JPY 2.12T** on AI component demand; OP maintained at **JPY 160B**. 2H division estimates are framed as **"somewhat prudent."** 
• **Capital Expenditure:** Will be revised **upward** beyond initial peak plans due to sustained strong capacity requests. 
• **Collaboration & Risks:** JAE European sales transfer starts **Jan 2027** (manufacturing framework **1H FY28**); domestic tungsten recycling refinery opens in **FY31**. 
• **Portfolio & ROE:** Business portfolio reviews remain an ongoing discipline after JPY 29.5B GaN impairment; management maintains steady target of **8%+ ROE by FY31**.
